summary: Parchment-map generator and skill: rebuild Map item parchments from .amd
author: pm
body:
The user asked for a reusable way to rebuild the Map item's parchment maps for every map. In their words: "Send an agent to keep refining the skill until we can pass it a generated tile map and get a proper parchment map out", "Goal is a recreation of the default map", and "the text on the parchment paper can be left out".

Built `tools/parchment_map/make_parchment.py`, which turns an `.amd` file into a 300x300 RGBA parchment with no text, in the style of `interface/newmaps`. Installed the project skill `parchment-map` after two read-only reviews (the first asked for fixes, the second passed).

| fact | value | kind |
|---|---|---|
| `default` ink correlation with the original | 0.453 | measured |
| paper mean colour, generated vs original | (174,145,101) vs (174,145,99) | measured |
| maps rendered | 79 of 79, no failures, under 1 s each | measured |
| bad input (truncated, wrong file, missing, size out of range) | one `error:` line, exit 2 | measured |

Weak spots, from the agent's own read of the output:
- cities lack the town road grid;
- dense mazes come out busy;
- some arenas and interiors show a straight line along the map edge;
- farms get swords their originals don't have.

**Not done:** using the generated maps in the client. The Map dialog only knows the 10 original maps.

**Done when:** the tool and skill are committed. In-game use is a separate decision.

Source: session 2026-11-24; sheets in `.claude/scratch/parchment_agent/final/`.
